# Review notes after an edit

Review notes are comments in the Markdown, after the block they are about.
This file has two. Press **E**, type a line at the top, save with
**Ctrl+S** and leave the editor. Then open the first note from the rail
and delete it: its comment goes, and nothing else changes.

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog, and the *second* sentence of
this paragraph is the one the first note is about.

<!-- review "second sentence": say which fox -->

| Step | What to check |
|:-----|:--------------|
| Delete a note after saving an edit | only its comment line is gone |
| Change a note after saving an edit | only its words change |

- A list item with **bold** words and `code`.
- A second item, which the other note is about.
